design_source_of_truth.location: src/pages/, src/components/, src/platform/ with brand-kit/brand-guidelines.md for visual identity

primary_users: People managing a personal or household budget who value privacy, clarity and explicit control over financial records
primary_jobs: Know what is safe to spend
Manage budgets, recurring commitments and savings goals
Export, restore or back up data without losing ownership

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA for shared web surfaces and equivalent Android accessibility semantics for the packaged application

design_system.component_source: src/components/ plus the semantic tokens/styles owned by the application code

critical_journeys.name: Inspect the month, record/review spending and understand the resulting safe-to-spend/budget state
Export/import supported user data while preserving deterministic ledger semantics
Review an Android payment candidate before it can enter the canonical ledger

reference_views: public/landing/aura-home.png and related current landing captures
brand-kit/brand-kit-visual.png plus reachable loading/empty/error states in production components/tests

validation.visual_regression: Targeted landing/reference captures and Playwright failure screenshots; no broad permanent screenshot archive
validation.manual_accessibility: TalkBack, focus order, text scaling, contrast and reduced-motion checks before promotion when affected
validation.usability_evidence: Closed-beta/release-decision evidence for high-risk user workflows when justified
